facts.fact: The article says the Independent Information Commission is enforcing compliance with the country's Freedom of Information Act of 2010 across public bodies.

The article reports the Independent Information Commission, with an Executive Director and outreach and compliance directors, running a compliance campaign under the Freedom of Information Act from 11 August to 2 September 2026; the document gives no date for the Commission's setting up, so this is dated to its publication on 6 September 2026.

note: The campaign is outreach and training with no decisions or figures of requests or complaints, so no applied fact.
